name: zanger
description: Browse current workspace files and review local or branch Git changes with Zanger.

interface.shortDescription: Explore workspace files and Git changes.
interface.longDescription: Browse a three-level file tree, fuzzy-search every file and folder, read source previews, and inspect local changes or committed differences against a target branch. Runs locally using Zanger and Git.
defaultPrompt: Use Zanger to show files in this workspace.
Use Zanger to review my current Git changes.
Use Zanger to compare this branch against main.
